correctness.rationale: TARGET route: Theorem 1.1 claims F_{d,k}=<psi^k L>_d=I^{log}_{d,k} via Lemma 4.1 weight |det|*C(val+k-1,k) and floor stretching. Lemma 4.1 is false: Blomme-Markwig Prop 3.14 multiplicity is |det|*prod m_V with tropical psi-weight 1 for one marking, no binomial; |det|=1 after floor normalization is false (BM conic has det 2, mult 2*2/2=2). Stretching with n=3d-1-k points does not force floor decomposition. Numerically refuted: reran psi_enum2.py reproducing F=(6,32,858) for (d,k)=(1,1),(2,1),(3,1) vs BM hpsiL=(2,4,60), and F=147 vs 29 for (2,2). Hence F=tropical fails; tropical=log leg is only quoted, not proved.

originality.rationale: No prior states the submitted psi-floor bijection F_{d,k}=<psi^k L>_d. Blomme-Markwig gives WDVV recursion for psi-L and explicitly states no floor-diagram algorithm is known for psi paired with line; Block-Gathmann-Markwig gives psi-floor diagrams only for stationary psi+point; Mandel-Ruddat gives general tropical=log correspondence with no floor side. Full-text inspection confirms none defines or implies the binomial F object, so headline is not recorded or mechanically implied (it is novel but incorrect).

value.rationale: A correct floor diagram for non-stationary psi-L would be valuable (BM gap), but submitted F is incorrect per above numerical contradiction, so no reliable exact invariant survives. The k=0 case F_{d,0}=d*N_d is a trivial d-fold copy of classical N_d, mechanically implied. The k>=1 tables are wrong-weight enumerations with no independent interpretation; integrality/finiteness certification alone does not create value under STANDARD.
